description: qou-cds1 Step 24: both readings of the 0.0566-vs-2.0204 gap are CLOSED. CHECK A -- across k=3..6 and every partition, the ONLY distinct |arg| of a complex eigenvalue of rho_lambda(Delta_L) is 2.02044502, in blocks of dimension 1..16. The reason is structural and is standard representation theory: an H_3 element acts block-diagonally on the H_3-isotypic decomposition of lambda|H_3, so the tower REPEATS the H_3 spectrum and cannot add to it -- closing this reading for every H_3-induced operator, not just Delta_L. CHECK B -- theta_eig/theta_req = 35.700, not an integer; seven pre-declared fraction candidates all miss, the closest (theta/22) by 62 %. The non-numerological version settles it: theta_req is (z-1)h/2 - u/2, a function of z, so reading theta_eig as a ladder phase requires z = 20.37 or -18.29 against admissible z_D = 0.6127, z_C = 0.4993 -- different ranges, not a rational factor. What remains open is the one thing Step 22's correction opened: a genuinely level-k operator not induced from H_3.

assertions.detail: the only distinct |arg| anywhere in k=3..6 is 2.02044502, in blocks of dimension 1..16, with 0 eig failures — the tower repeats the H_3 spectrum and adds nothing

assertions.detail: structural: an H_3 element acts block-diagonally on the H_3-isotypic decomposition, so spec at level k is the H_3 spec with multiplicity. Standard rep theory, cited not proved; the measurement is consistent with it at every block

assertions.name: no_declared_fraction_lands
assertions.detail: closest of 7 pre-declared candidates is theta/22 at ratio 1.62274, 62.27 % off. No search beyond the declared list

assertions.name: eigenphase_read_as_a_ladder_phase_needs_inadmissible_z
assertions.detail: z = 20.369566 or -18.288085 against admissible z_D = 0.61268804, z_C = 0.49932033 — the two phases are not related by a rational factor, they live in different ranges

assertions.name: both_readings_closed_elliptic_generator_is_not_the_ladders
assertions.detail: Delta_L supplies a genuine elliptic generator whose ellipticity is a fact about the nucleons (Step 23), but its phase is not the ladder's and neither tower level nor a rational factor bridges the gap

parameters.anti_fit: candidate list fixed before computing; all reported

context.axis: qou-cds1: can tower level or a rational factor bridge 0.0566 vs 2.0204?
context.answer: Neither. The tower carries exactly one eigenphase for any H_3-induced operator (block-diagonal on the isotypic decomposition), and reading the eigenphase as a ladder phase requires an inadmissible z ~ 20.4 or -18.3. The elliptic generator exists and is not the ladder's.
context.leaves_open: a genuinely level-k operator not induced from H_3 — the one thing Step 22's correction opened, and by Check A the only place in the tower a different phase could come from.
context.scope: Scope-(a). The block-diagonal argument is standard rep theory, cited not proved; what is verified is that the measured spectra agree with it at every block k=3..6. Nothing derived, proposed or wired.
